<function name="SpawnMenuEnabled" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>If false is returned then the spawn menu is never created. This saves load times if your mod doesn't actually use the spawn menu for any reason.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether to create spawnmenu or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
